video.title: Students talk about their WSMath journey
video.label: Video on Loom

featured.name: Alice Gao
featured.quote: He pinpoints specific areas where I need assistance and tailors his instruction to address my challenges.

featured.name: Kitty Lam
featured.quote: Winson’s explanations are clear and easy to understand. He patiently guides you through any concepts you find challenging. … and he’s always willing to answer your questions even outside of lesson time.

featured.name: CY Ting
featured.course: Edexcel IAL Maths and Further Maths
featured.quote: Winson老師擅長讓艱深乏味的內容變得有趣且易於理解。對於我的任何疑問，老師都會耐心解答，直至我明白。

featured.name: Cissie Ching
featured.quote: Winson老师的教学方式以习题练习为主，不断加强记忆并深入了解知识点，课后亦会有相应笔记供学生复习。

rowA.name: James Chow
rowA.quote: When I was nearly ready to give up, Siu Sir’s belief in me was pivotal.

rowA.name: Sharon Deng
rowA.quote: 我个人认为数学本身是一门实践大于理论，并需时刻保持手感的科目。

rowA.name: Joy Angela Sun
rowA.quote: Winson is very patient and experienced.

rowA.name: Cassie Luo
rowA.quote: 一节课中70%时间学生做题；30%时间老师讲课，这是 Winson 老师独特的教学方式。

rowA.name: Vera Jing
rowA.quote: Winson was the first and only Math tutor who supervised me throughout my IBDP.

rowA.name: Bill Zhang
rowA.course: CAIE A-Level Maths and Further Maths
rowA.quote: Winson 老师的上课风格轻松无压力，且教书模式灵活变通，将複杂的题目简单化是老师的强项之一，独树一帜的拆题及解题步骤使我获益匪浅。

rowA.name: Michelle Chan
rowA.quote: Winson was always well prepared and gave many past paper questions for practice after every lesson.

rowA.name: Kathy Ye
rowA.quote: Winson 非常高效的教学方式，让我找到了解题的窍门。

rowA.name: Jasmine Hung
rowA.quote: Winson is a patient tutor and well-prepared for every lesson, maximising the time spent in class.

rowA.name: Connie Feng
rowA.quote: 通过他的数学补课，我得以从最初难堪的分数，提升至我个人十分满意的成绩！

rowA.name: Lucia Zhu
rowA.quote: When I received my disappointing grade, I knew I had to get help immediately.

rowA.name: Coco Cheng
rowA.quote: 我认为 Winson 教学方法简洁明了，令人头疼且复杂的数学概念，通过老师的讲解变得十分易于理解。

rowB.name: Jason Yeung
rowB.quote: Mr. Siu is the best math teacher I have ever had. His explanations, particularly for calculus, are outstanding.

rowB.name: Jasmine Yang
rowB.quote: Mr. Siu’s teaching style is crystal clear, with easy-to-follow structures and a stash of super-relevant questions.

rowB.name: Kelly Li
rowB.quote: 老师对学生提问非常有耐性，即使讲了五次十次我都听不懂，他也能做到语气不改地重复解答。

rowB.name: Judy Wei
rowB.quote: Winson's tutoring helped me immensely during the COVID-19 online class period.

rowB.name: Vivian Chen
rowB.quote: Finding Winson as my IBDP Math tutor was an incredible stroke of luck! He truly saved me from my struggles with IBDP Math HL.

rowB.name: Gordon Lo
rowB.quote: Winson is a kind and reliable mentor, which is why I enjoy mathematics so much.

rowB.name: Aidan Cheung
rowB.quote: Winson is a great Math Tutor who breaks down concepts easily and applies his learning to practical exam questions.

rowB.name: David Zhang
rowB.quote: His teaching style and the “by topic” past paper question bank are highly recommended.

rowB.name: Ken Chen
rowB.quote: Winson has a unique teaching approach that I greatly admire.

rowB.name: Nicole Li
rowB.quote: Winson has helped me improve my math in just one year. He gave me many past papers on different topics, which have drastically improved my math scores.

rowB.name: Lucy Han
rowB.quote: 他溫柔細緻，每堂會按課題提供筆記與試題，逐題拆解我的錯題，講清背後邏輯，讓我下次遇到同類題有清晰思路。

rowB.name: Cherish Chiu
rowB.quote: 其實佢會帶住你做Past Paper，認真一對一講解嗰啲唔識嘅題目，做到你識為止。
